<!--format PROJECT_STATE is what is true NOW: current focus, in-progress work, blockers, next steps. Overwrite stale lines; never append dated history. Every line must be understandable without this session's context: concrete names, no unexplained shorthand, no cross-references by list number. [user] flag — one judgment per line: does this need the user (their decision, their action, or something they'd be sorry to miss — including things they assigned to themselves)? If yes, insert [user] after the list marker of the line where the fact already lives: `- [user] <text>` or `3. [user] <text>`. Flagging marks a line, never creates one: one fact = one entry, never duplicated into another section. A dated commitment needing no decision is `[due:YYYY-MM-DD]` (shows on the calendar). Machine attributes (id, created, touched, resolved) live in a daemon-managed mem-comment on the next line — never write or edit these comments; leave them exactly where they are. Never auto-decide: spending money, sending external messages as the user, or irreversible/destructive acts are always surfaced, whatever the autonomy setting. Write timeless ("due Jul 28", never "tomorrow"). A line whose mem-comment carries resolved:<date> is settled — on consolidation rewrite it as the completed fact or drop it; never re-open or re-flag it. CLOSE THE LOOP THE SAME TURN: the moment the user answers a flagged line, decides it, or does it, remove the [user] flag from that line in this turn — rewrite the line as the settled fact (`- Chose option A.`) and leave the mem-comment alone. You are the only reader who can see both the flag and the user's answer; consolidation runs later, sees a truncated window, and cannot do this for you. A flagged line you leave behind after it is answered keeps nagging the user for something they already gave you. Never flag a question you asked during this session — flag the decision that is still genuinely open, written so someone who was not here can act on it.-->

# 当前状态

## 焦点
用户要求用 GameFactory-3A 框架全面重构 CS1.5。已读框架入口（agent_skills/setting_overview.md + GitHub README）：
- 流程 = 澄清简报 → 规划 → 资产生成与QA → 引擎内构建（读 engine_overview→code_gen Skill→对应引擎 API）→ 真实游玩+录屏验证
- 引擎 three.js：规范在 agent_skills/engine_context/three_js_api.md，参考代码在 engine_adapters/three_js/（尚未读，待执行方案确认后读）
- **待用户确认执行方式**（引擎=three.js 已定；重构方式/范围/验证/资产来源/备份 5 项未答），确认前不动手。此前 miniapp-simulator 崩溃修复（第五轮防御性初始化）已完成打包。
- #1 toneMapping：renderer 加 ACESFilmicToneMapping + exposure 1.1（高光收敛不过曝）
- #2 贴图懒加载：textures.js（5.2MB base64）从静态脚本移除，改为 main.js 菜单期动态注入，onload 后 weapon.applyTextures()/gameMap.applyTextures() 重放（启动不再被 5.2MB 解析阻塞）
- #3 低端降级：navigator.hardwareConcurrency≤4 → 关软阴影（PCFSoft→PCF）、DPR 上限 1.25
- #4 合并 draw call：AK 复进簧 14 环 + 防滑纹 40 点 → InstancedMesh（同几何实例化，14+40 个 draw call 降到 2）
- node --check main/weapon/map 通过；zip 4.2MB
- 软件团队×3D技能全面评估已完成（3D 模型/架构/性能/体验四视角，见对话报告）
- 3d-animation-short-generator 已移除；ai-content-creator-team/software-company/3d-web-experience 已安装

## 修复清单（8/8）
1. 触控三通道双触发 — 已符合（bindPress 本就是单 Pointer 通道，QA 误读 if/else，无需改）
2. textures.js 8.1MB→5.2MB — usp.png 缩到 1024×1024（tools/resize-usp.ps1）
3. waves 指数膨胀 — config 加 maxCount:14 / hpCap:300，main.js _nextWave 应用 Math.min 封顶
4. worldToScreen 旋转逆变换 — hud.js 按 body.rotated 做屏幕系→内容系（LESSONS#16：内容x=屏幕y、内容y=内容高-屏幕x）；main.js 加 body.rotated class
5. 开镜后换弹不重置 fov — weapon.js startReload 与切枪一致：FOV 回 CONFIG.fov + 隐藏 scopeOverlay + 恢复准星
6. #rotateHint 纯 CSS — style.css 改 @media (hover:none) and (pointer:coarse) and (orientation:portrait)；main.js 移除 JS toggle，continue 按钮改加 .hidden
7. 营销物料失实 — README/小红书-cs15笔记/爆款版/封面提示词 同步为"3 武器 + 随机 8~12 波"（新版 小红书-cs15笔记-20260818.md 本就正确）
8. 魔法数字 — weapon.js 硬编码 FOV 75 全部改 CONFIG.fov（switchTo/startReload/_toggleScopeZoom）；贴图函数重复属低风险重构，暂记 TODO

## 验证与产物
- node --check main/weapon/hud/config 全部通过
- cs1.5-minitool.zip = 4.2MB（textures.js 8.1→5.2MB 后体积下降）
- 旧包备份 cs1.5-minitool.backup-20260817.zip

## 待验证
- [user] 手机实测：波次封顶后单局时长、飘字位置（旋转容器逆变换）、换弹自动关镜、横屏提示纯 CSS 显隐、整体性能（textures.js 减负后冷启动）
  <!--mem id:fe7711 created:2026-08-19 touched:2026-08-19-->
- [user] 之前 AWP 开镜/换枪循环/边拖边射 的实测是否通过
